This indicates that Omeprazole may influence gastric ulcer pathology, which in turn could affect gastrin secretion. The scores from the two paths are consistent, suggesting a moderate level of support for this relationship. The strength of the evidence is moderate, and further research would be needed to establish a definitive link.
